steps.title: Make the dough
steps.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 64 64'><rect x='14' y='16' width='36' height='8' rx='4'/><rect x='6' y='18' width='8' height='4' rx='2'/><rect x='50' y='18' width='8' height='4' rx='2'/><ellipse cx='32' cy='42' rx='18' ry='10'/></svg>
steps.instruction: Sift the flour into a bowl and mix with the salt. Crumble in the butter, then work in cold water a little at a time and knead quickly into a smooth dough that isn't sticky. Shape into a ball and chill for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Macerate the apples
steps.instruction: Peel and quarter the apples, remove the cores, and cut into wedges about 1/2 cm wide. Toss with the juice of half a lemon and 50 g of the sugar, then let sit for an hour.

steps.title: Drain and make the glaze
steps.instruction: Drain the apples in a sieve, catching the juice. Stir the juice together with the egg yolk to make a glaze for later.

steps.title: Preheat and prep the pan
steps.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 64 64'><rect x='10' y='10' width='44' height='44' rx='3'/><rect x='18' y='20' width='28' height='24' rx='2'/></svg>
steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees C, top and bottom heat. Butter a 28 cm tart pan.

steps.title: Line the pan
steps.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 64 64'><circle cx='32' cy='38' r='18'/><rect x='14' y='12' width='36' height='7' rx='3.5'/><rect x='6' y='13.5' width='8' height='4' rx='2'/><rect x='50' y='13.5' width='8' height='4' rx='2'/></svg>
steps.instruction: Roll the dough out thin on a floured surface, line the pan, and press it up the sides. Brush the base with the egg white.

steps.title: Arrange the apples
steps.icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 64 64'><circle cx='32' cy='32' r='22'/><circle cx='32' cy='32' r='14'/><circle cx='32' cy='32' r='6'/></svg>
steps.instruction: Arrange the apple wedges in circles over the dough, sprinkle with the remaining 50 g of sugar, and drizzle with the melted butter.

steps.title: Bake on the oven floor
steps.instruction: Place the tart on the floor of the oven for 5 to 10 minutes, until the edge starts to brown.

steps.title: Move to the middle and glaze
steps.instruction: Move the tart to the middle rack and bake for another 10 minutes. Brush with the egg yolk and apple juice glaze.

steps.title: Finish baking
steps.instruction: Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes, until the crust turns a deep golden brown.

steps.title: Serve
steps.instruction: Serve warm or fully cooled, both work well.
